label: Whatever has the nine SIMPLE_4, PERFECT_2, INFINITE_1 attributes is IMMENSE_2
paraphrase: Whatever is simple, universally perfect, supremely good, such that whatever is GOD_4 is it (IsTheOneGod: uniqueness only), infinite, altogether immutable, eternal, and has intellect and will is IMMENSE_2: it is INFINITE_1 and causes the being of every other being in act as to being. Derived with no premise (nineAreImmenseAsInfiniteCauseOfAll): infinity is one of the nine, and the creator conjunct is contained by definition in supreme goodness, so this is a definitional unfolding, not an independent warrant. IMMENSE_2 is not IMMENSE_1 (the primitive immensity of the Dei Filius attributes): place, containment, measure, presence by power and by knowledge, and immediacy of presence are not typed.
